maddeler.e:
نتمالك (form VI)
# نَتَمَالَكُ (natamālaku) /na.ta.maː.la.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
# نُتَمَالَكُ (nutamālaku) /nu.ta.maː.la.ku/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
# نَتَمَالَكَ (natamālaka) /na.ta.maː.la.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَالَكَ (tamālaka)
# نُتَمَالَكَ (nutamālaka) /nu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
